about:
TaxiTimer
==================
A simple addon that adds flight time to the taxi map. Note that the timer can be a bit off as the addon is in its early stages of development.

You can customize the addon in the Edit Mode or in the Options AddOns tab.

If you use the bar mode you can hold Shift and drag it around.

# TaxiTimer

## [v12.1.5.261125](https://github.com/Vladinator/wow-addon-taxitimer/tree/v12.1.5.261125) (2026-11-25)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Vladinator/wow-addon-taxitimer/commits/v12.1.5.261125) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Vladinator/wow-addon-taxitimer/releases)

- Additional sim improvements based on recorded flights.  
- More analysis and adjustments based on the findings.  
- TOC bump.  
- MOP and possibly other flavors don't all have all the frame events we register, so created a safe registration method to avoid errors.  
- Adjusted the default options.  
- Expanded the wipe command to also include the gossip flights.  
- TOC bump.  
- Added gossip flights as a concept.  
    Requires a manually maintained database to function, but also added a discovery service that when recording is enabled, it detects when a gossip puts us on a flight and stores data about it in the SavedVariables for later analysis.  
    Currently added both Moonglade flight paths for Druids for the regular game.  
    Each game flavor needs its own mapping over gossip flights as we can't harvest this from the gamefiles.  
    Users can enable the recording function and share their SavedVariables file for analysis.  
- Added gossip support for options that puts the player on a taxi.  
- - TOC bump.  
    - Added LibEditMode and added settings in Edit Mode and in the Interface AddOn settings section.  
    - Added options for mode, timer and destinations and some customization.  
- TOC bump.  
- We start flights by hooking `TakeTaxiNode` instead of using the UI hooks.  
- Added simple info about the slash command.  
- Slight adjustment.  
- TOC bump.  
- Split up and refactored all the scripts.  
- Minor fixes.  
- Cleanup.  
- Additional improvements.  
- Additional simulation improvements.  
- Improvements to simulations when we don't have a position like in instances.  
- The bar is click-through until shift is held, then it can be dragged.  
- TOC bump.  
- The new default visualization is "bar" mode. (No need to hijack the stopwatch like before.)  
    Additional improvements to simulations and analysis.  
- Added a bar and options through slash commands on how the bar looks. Defaults are like before, but it makes it easier to toggle some flags now.  
    Improvements to the analyzer to better catch and apply patches to flights.  
- Sim improvements.  
- TOC bump.  
- Additional adjustments.  
- Moved the lib related code in its own lib. Adjusted the code to fit the new format.  
- Moved the library files into their own library instance to keep it separate from the addon code itself. Still a bit of WIP and cleanup to do.  
- TOC bump.  
- Added the recent SV data to the collection.  
- Additional simulations improvements.  
- Additional simulation improvements.  
- Additional simulation improvements.  
- Additional simulation and analysis improvements and tooling.  
- Additional simulation improvements.  
- Additional simulation improvements.  
- Split up the old core.lua into separate files.  
    Rewrote the PHP scripts to a pure lua implementation that we can run through the lua binary to do the same as we did with PHP.  
- Split the simulation into flavors so we have more flexibility with our adjustments.  
- Added more simulation adjustments.  
- Additional simulation improvements based on analysis.  
- Further simulation improvements and analysis work.  
- Added simple readme file for the scripts folder.  
- Removed debug flags. Should not have been on by default.  
- Updated to the latest DB files and added forever.  
- DB update and recorder implementation for debugging. Analyzer to be used to analyze SV data for deviations from the simulated path. Fixed minor bugs and issues with path calculations.  
- TOC bump.  
- Exposed `TaxiTimerAPI` with functions for others to use in their addons.  
- TOC bump and DB updates for 12.1
